paper_000_chameleon.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
key_findings: Early-fusion token-based mixed-modal model using discrete image tokens (1024 tokens from 8192 codebook for 512x512 images)
Single transformer handles both understanding and generation
Achieves SOTA on VQA/captioning, competitive on text-only tasks
Core weakness: tokenizer struggles with text-heavy images (OCR limitation)
Stability techniques: QK-Norm, dropout, Swin-style normalization reordering

metrics.image_generation: non-trivial but limited by tokenizer OCR weakness

paper_001_llava.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
key_findings: Connects CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder to Vicuna LLM via linear projection
GPT-4 assisted visual instruction data generation (158K samples)
85.1% relative score vs GPT-4 on synthetic multimodal instruction dataset
92.53% accuracy on Science QA when ensembled with GPT-4

paper_002_siglip.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
key_findings: Pairwise sigmoid loss replaces softmax contrastive loss
More memory efficient, enables larger batch sizes
SigLiT: 79.7% zero-shot ImageNet in 1 day on 4 TPUv4 chips
SigLIP: 73.4% zero-shot ImageNet in 5 days on 32 TPUv4 chips

paper_003_llamagen.title: Autoregressive Model Beats Diffusion: Llama for Scalable Image Generation
key_findings: Vanilla AR models achieve SOTA image generation with proper scaling
Image tokenizer: downsample ratio 16, rFID 0.94, codebook usage 97%
LlamaGen-3B achieves 2.18 FID on ImageNet 256x256, beating LDM/DiT
Text-conditional model (775M) trained on LAION-COCO + aesthetics data
